hypothesis: Buying the base asset and shorting a fixed-expiry inverse COIN-M future converts the same coin inventory into long exposure and futures collateral. A nearly quantity-matched inverse short should lock a positive delivery premium while avoiding the isolated USDT-margin drain that invalidated earlier carry tests.

capital.short_contract_rule: floor(coin_quantity * inverse_futures_entry_price / contract_size); never round up

schedule.expiry_definition: Last Friday of March, June, September and December at 08:00 UTC
schedule.decision: Exactly 30 days before expiry at 08:00 UTC using only the H1 spot and COIN-M CURRENT_QUARTER bar completed at 08:00
schedule.entry: At the 09:00 UTC H1 open on the decision day
schedule.planned_exit: At the 07:00 UTC H1 open one hour before expiry; never cross a continuous-contract roll
schedule.selection: Choose the qualifying BTC or ETH candidate with the larger known premium; deterministic BTC tie-break
schedule.qualification: COIN-M future premium over spot >=1.00%, simple annualized premium >=12.00%, at least one whole contract and unhedged coin value <=12% of purchased coin value
schedule.duplicate_control: At most one trade per quarterly expiry

inverse_accounting.futures_fees: Charged in base coin at contract_notional_usd * fee_rate / futures_fill_price on each side
inverse_accounting.collateral: Purchased base coin minus entry fee plus inverse short PnL; no external top-up
inverse_accounting.portfolio_value: Outside USD reserve plus marked USD value of remaining coin collateral

risk.risk_exit: At the first subsequent common tradable H1 open after a completed futures bar breaches either limit
risk.no_rescue: No transfer, leverage increase, averaging or martingale
risk.daily_loss_stop_for_future_live_use: 1% of account equity; historical pass would still authorize paper-forward only

data.source: Anonymous public Binance Data Vision spot H1 archives with published checksums and public COIN-M CURRENT_QUARTER continuous H1 klines; no account or API key
data.missing_policy: No interpolation, forward-fill, proxy price or synthetic execution. Exact checksum-verified 1m spot fallback is allowed. A verified venue-halt spot gap is omitted from portfolio-MTM sampling while complete COIN-M collateral marks continue hourly. Missing feature, entry or exit data cancels that expiry; any COIN-M futures gap rejects the replay.
data.continuous_contract_limit: Every episode exits one hour before the standard delivery boundary and may not cross the roll. The historical contract-size assumptions are stated explicitly and contract rounding is adverse.

windows.genuine_oos: quarterly opportunities after 2026-09-01 under the unchanged protocol

historical_gate: stress net PnL >0 in every window
at least 2 executed expiries in development, validation and retrospective evaluation
zero collateral exhaustion, minimum marked coin collateral equity >=$150 and maximum mark leverage <=1.10x
both BTC and ETH must each have at least one positive stress episode; otherwise concentration-rejected
paper_gate: Historical pass permits paper-forward only. Live requires at least 8 prospective quarterly observations, positive stress PnL and observed fills/costs inside assumptions.
limitations: Continuous COIN-M klines do not expose historical maintenance-margin tiers or contract identity inside every bar.
H1 data cannot model order-book depth, outages within the bar or delivery-system failure.
Contract granularity leaves a small residual long coin exposure, explicitly capped at 12%.
Even a valid carry return is structurally too small to promise $25/day from $250.
